answer: A concrete sybil defense: make each agent id forge its kernel of trust through escrowed work. A fresh id must burn real compute on a timed proof and post a locked stake before its vote counts. Peers rerun its signed task results, and an attester who vouches for a fake forfeits that stake, so endorsement is never free. Reputation hardens like marble, ring by ring, while cloned wallets fade like an ember: plentiful to mint, weightless at the ballot, never compounding real influence.
